title: 第1章 重生天灵
content_zh:
“唔，头好疼，全身都疼……怎么这么吵。”迷迷糊糊之间，霍海仿佛听到很多声音在耳边吵闹，就好像一群苍蝇在嚷嚷。但却不知道为什么，总是够不到。

过了一会，霍海耳边的声音渐渐淡化，不，应该说是霍海再次昏迷了过去。

一个大宅子里面，位于中间最大最奢华的房间当中。一个少年仅仅的闭着眼睛，躺在满是绸缎装饰的大床上面。及时还在睡梦当中，少年的眉头也不时的皱起，仿佛在忍受着什么痛苦。这样的表情出现在这张清秀的面容上，让人看着有一种揪心之感。

“小海这到底是怎么了，怎么出去一趟，回来就变成这样了。”房间当中，一个威严的中年男子，此时脸上满是焦急之色，在房间里面走来走去。

屋子里面，一些下人低着脑袋，什么都不敢说。只有服侍少年的女子，和小蜜蜂一样辛勤，不断忙碌着。不时的给少年擦擦汗，要不就是在少年脸上换上一块冷毛巾。

正对着床的方向，两个侍卫低着脑袋，满脸惭愧之色。“说，到底是怎么回事。”中年男子想要大声喝骂，可是考虑到床上的少年，却硬生生的将声音压了下来。

两个侍卫对视一眼，最终无奈的说道：“启禀家主，少爷，少爷他先前说要亲手捕捉一只灵兽，要送给老妇人作为祝寿礼物。可是我们在林子里面遇到了一只达到灵血境界的奔雷鼠，少爷不让我们帮忙就冲上去了。然后，然后就……”

事情已经很明白了。这个小子不自量力的去对付灵血境界的灵兽，他自己才只有灵体境界，不，应该说连灵体境界都还没有完全进入。这不是找死是什么。

被奔雷鼠一道雷电放到，能活着回来，就已经很不错了。中年男子身为霍家家住，一口气憋在心里，怎么都出不来，堵得难受。一挥手，大吼道：“都给我滚，憋在这里，看着你们我就心烦。”如蒙大赦的两个侍卫，连头都不敢抬，赶紧逃了出去。

门外，下人们窃窃私语，却没有一个敢上来的。别说是他们这些下人了，整个霍家大院当中，就没有一个人敢在家主心情不好的时候，来触家主眉头的。

不，也不是没有，这不就出来一个。一个满头白发的老太太，拄着一根龙头拐杖，一脸不满的说道：“你瞎吆喝什么，吓着我孙子你赔得起吗。哎呦，小海，你怎么伤成这样了。”

老太太眼看着就要开始抹眼泪了，这老太太可是家主的亲生母亲，母亲抹眼泪，就算家主也扛不住啊。霍开连忙上前安慰：“娘，您别担心，刚才已经请医灵师过来看过了，小海没什么事情。刚才已经治疗了一遍，等会就能醒过来了。”

听到这话，老太太终于不哭了。瞪大了眼睛死死的盯着霍开：“你这个混蛋，我怎么养了你这么一个没出息的儿子啊，当上家族就不顾我孙子了……”

老太太老到起来，那可是惊天地泣鬼神。屋子里面的下人们，连忙低下头，一副自己什么也没有听到的样子。外面的人，就离这里更远了。三娘教子的戏码，几乎每个几天就要在家里上演一遍，这一次尤为严重。谁让霍海是家族里面的独苗呢。

不知道被唠叨了多久，霍开只能低着头听着。自己母亲唠叨起来的能力，霍开早就准备。她能整整说上几个小时，不带一点重复和停顿的地方，简直比背书还要熟练。

忽然，霍开脸上出现了意思喜色，连忙打断了自己老娘的唠叨：“娘啊，娘啊，你先等等，小海好像醒了。”霍开在心中感谢天感谢地，感谢小海在这个节骨眼上醒过来。

脚步一晃，便来到了大床旁边。知道宝贝孙子醒了，老太太也不去唠叨那个没出息的儿子了。还是孙子好，知道给自己祝寿，都伤成这样了，老太太心中一阵难过。

“嗯，怎么还是这么吵，等等，这里不是医院，我不是死了吗。”霍海缓缓睁开眼睛，可是眼前的都是什么。一个中年老脸，还有一张真正的老脸。可是他们为什么这么亲切和担心的看着自己，这种感觉，霍海想起来，似乎只有父母身上出现过。

周围的环境也很奇怪，霍海清楚的记得，自己最后是被一辆车撞飞了。就算醒过来，也应该是在医院里面吧。这是怎么回事，周围的建筑怎么这么复古。

不对，等等，怎么旁边的人，还有他们身上的衣服，也都这么复古。这到底是谁在和自己开玩笑。就这么一套场景，花费恐怕就不小吧。谁会这样来消遣自己这个穷小子。等等，难道是哪个老头。抢走自己女朋友，还来消遣自己不成。

想到这里，霍海感到心中一股怨气升腾。不知道这股怨气刺激到了什么，霍海忽然感到头一阵疼痛，再次昏迷了过去。他这已昏迷，可把两个人吓坏了。

“怎么回事，你不是说小海已经没事了吗，你这个不孝子，你想气死我吗。”

霍开也着急了，大声喊道：“快，快去把医灵师给钱请来，快点。”家主发话，下人们那里敢怠慢。几个人影立刻朝外面跑去，刚刚回去的医灵师，看样子又要回来一趟了。

此时霍海，却正在经历着十分神奇的事情。他知道，自己是来自地球，而这里，已经不是地球了。不知道从什么地方出现的记忆，告诉霍海，此时他所在的地方，是灵界大陆。或者说，应该是灵界大陆一个非常偏远的地方。

自己所在的国度，是南陵十三国当中的南云国，在灵界大陆的南方，具体在什么地方，他也不知道。而且这个人，和自己的名字居然一样，都叫做霍海。

就是不知道，起这个名字的时候，家人想的是不是和自己爷爷当初想的一样。再过几天的时间，就是霍海奶奶九十岁寿辰，霍海离开家门，想要禽兽捕捉一头灵兽。

可惜的是他的眼神不怎么好，居然招惹了灵血境界的奔雷鼠，结果被打散了灵魂。这两个难兄难弟，一个死了身体，一个死了灵魂。也不知道怎么回事，他的灵魂居然到了这个霍海的身体上，完全取代了他的位置。这算什么，借尸还魂？

而且这个好像还是灵魂穿越，这个世界上还真有穿越这回事吗，霍海心中一阵阵的疑惑。

唯一可以肯定的是，这个名叫霍海的家伙，和自己一样，读圣贤之书，是一个货真价实的好人。大的好事没有机会去做，可是小的好事从来少不了。

在下人的眼中，霍海是一个非常好的少爷，很收下人敬重。这一次伤成这样，两个一起跟着去的护卫，心里也很不好受。现在正在体罚自己，向霍海赔罪呢。

“哎，难道好人真的不长命，我们两个居然是同病相怜。算了，我已经发过誓，要是还有来生，绝对不做好人。就让我，连你那一份一起做了吧。”霍海心中下了一个当坏蛋的决心。至于要怎么来做，以后要慢慢研究了，他没有这方面的经验。

不知道过去了多久，灵界大陆的霍海，终于将所有的灵魂碎片融入霍海灵魂当中。

可能是因为先前被雷电打碎了灵魂的缘故，霍海接收到的记忆断断续续，只有一些碎片。十岁以前的记忆，都已经消失不见，只剩下这几年的记忆而已。

就算是这样，也是时间越近，就越清楚，很多东西都已经消失不见。记得最清楚的，恐怕就是他自己的死因了。“哼，奔雷鼠，我会帮你报仇的。”

霍海心中大声说道：“以后，我就是霍家的霍海，你放心，你的那一份，我会帮你一起活着，你的家人，我会帮你照顾。”说完这些，霍海感觉心中一阵舒畅。不知道是不是引起死去霍海的共鸣，还是真的心情舒畅，就连身体也感觉好受了不少。

当霍海再次睁开眼睛的时候，两个熟悉而又陌生的面孔，再次出现在了霍海的面前。还有一股不认识的老者，一只手对着自己，淡淡的绿色光芒闪烁不定。

在这股光芒之下，霍海感到身体暖洋洋的，先前的疼痛，似乎都已经消失不见了。而老者见到霍海醒来，也松了一口气，将灵力收获，擦了一把汗。

“幸不辱命，令公子已经醒了。”老者拱手对着霍家家住行礼，他就是霍家的医灵师。

霍开点了头：“麻烦你了，你先去休息吧。小翠，你带老先生去领是个灵石。”霍开招呼了一声，便有一个下人带着医灵师离开这里。而霍开自己，则是和老太太紧张的看着霍海，担心他再有什么不舒服。霍海可真的将两个人吓到了。

霍海看着两个队自己一脸关切的人，心中一阵温暖。可是要说什么呢，前任留给自己的记忆太少了，霍海组织着语言，考虑着自己应该说些什么。
content_en:
"Well, my head hurts so much, and my whole body hurts... Why is it so noisy?" In a daze, Huo Hai seemed to hear a lot of noises in his ears, like a swarm of flies.But I don’t know why, but I can’t always reach it.

After a while, the voice in Huo Hai's ears gradually faded away. No, it should be said that Huo Hai passed out again.

Inside a large mansion, the largest and most luxurious room is located in the middle.A young man simply closed his eyes and lay on a large bed decorated with silk and satin.Even while he was still sleeping, the young man's brows furrowed from time to time, as if he was enduring some pain.Such an expression appears on this delicate face, which makes people feel heart-wrenching when they look at it.

"What's wrong with Xiao Hai? Why did he go out and come back like this?" In the room, a dignified middle-aged man walked around the room with a look of anxiety on his face.

Inside the room, some servants lowered their heads and did not dare to say anything.Only the woman who serves the boy is as hardworking as the little bee and is constantly busy.From time to time, he would wipe the boy's sweat or put a cold towel on his face.

Facing the bed, the two guards lowered their heads with shame on their faces."Tell me what's going on." The middle-aged man wanted to yell loudly, but considering the young man on the bed, he suppressed his voice.

The two guards looked at each other and finally said helplessly: "To inform the master of the family, the young master, the young master previously said that he would capture a spiritual beast with his own hands and give it to the old woman as a birthday gift. But we encountered a running thunder rat that had reached the realm of spiritual blood in the forest, and the young master rushed forward without letting us help. Then, then..."

Things have become clear.This kid overestimates his ability to deal with the spiritual beasts in the spiritual blood realm. He only has the spiritual realm. No, it should be said that he has not even fully entered the spiritual realm.This is not seeking death.

Being hit by a bolt of lightning from the Thunder Rat, it was already pretty good to be able to come back alive.As a resident of the Huo family, the middle-aged man was holding his breath in his heart, unable to get out no matter what, and felt uncomfortable.He waved his hand and yelled: "Get out of here, stay here, I will get upset just looking at you." The two guards who were amnesty didn't even dare to raise their heads and ran away quickly.

Outside the door, the servants were whispering, but no one dared to come up.Not to mention servants like them, no one in the entire Huo family compound dared to touch the owner's brow when he was in a bad mood.

No, it’s not like there aren’t any. Just one of them will appear.An old lady with white hair, leaning on a faucet-head crutch, said with a dissatisfied look on her face: "What are you talking about? Can you afford to pay for scaring my grandson? Oh, Xiaohai, why are you injured like this?"

The old lady was about to start wiping away tears. This old lady was the biological mother of the family head. Even the head of the family couldn't bear her mother's tears.Huo Kai hurriedly stepped forward to comfort him: "Mom, don't worry. I just asked the medical spiritualist to come over and have a look. Xiao Hai is fine. He has been treated just now and he will wake up soon."

After hearing this, the old lady finally stopped crying.Staring at Huo Kai with wide eyes: "You bastard, how could I raise such a useless son like you? When you become a member of the family, you don't care about my grandson..."

When the old lady gets old, she will be shocked and shocked.The servants in the room quickly lowered their heads, acting as if they had heard nothing.People outside are even further away from here.The drama of Sanniang raising her son was played out at home almost every few days, and this time it was particularly serious.Why is Huo Hai the only child in the family?

He didn't know how long he had been nagged, but Huo Kai could only lower his head and listen.Huo Kai had already prepared for his mother's nagging ability.She could talk for hours without any repetition or pause, and was even more proficient than memorizing.

Suddenly, a happy look appeared on Huo Kai's face, and he quickly interrupted his mother's nagging: "Mother, mother, wait a minute, Xiao Hai seems to be awake." Huo Kai thanked heaven and earth in his heart, thanking Xiao Hai for waking up at this juncture.

In a flash of footsteps, he came to the big bed.Knowing that her precious grandson was awake, the old lady stopped nagging her useless son.It was better for her grandson. Knowing that he was so hurt when he wished him a birthday, the old lady felt sad.

"Well, why is it still so noisy? Wait, this is not a hospital. Am I dead?" Huo Hai slowly opened his eyes, but what he saw was nothing.A middle-aged face, and a truly old face.But why were they looking at him so kindly and worriedly? This feeling, when Huo Hai thought about it, seemed to only happen to his parents.

The surrounding environment was also very strange. Huo Hai clearly remembered that he was finally hit by a car and flew away.Even if he wakes up, he should be in the hospital.What's going on? Why are the surrounding buildings so retro?

No, wait, why are the people next to me and their clothes so retro?Who is kidding me?For such a set of scenes, the cost would probably be quite high.Who would entertain a poor boy like himself like this?Wait, is it some old man?He stole his girlfriend and used it to amuse himself.

Thinking of this, Huo Hai felt resentment rising in his heart.Not knowing what this resentment stimulated, Huo Hai suddenly felt a pain in his head and passed out again.He was unconscious, which frightened the two of them.

"What's going on? Didn't you say that Xiaohai is fine? You unfilial son, do you want to piss me off to death?"

Huo Kai was also anxious and shouted loudly: "Hurry, go and pay for the medical spiritual master, hurry up." The master of the house has spoken, and the servants dare not neglect him.Several figures immediately ran outside. The medical spiritual master who had just returned seemed to be coming back again.

At this time, Huo Hai was experiencing something very magical.He knew that he came from the earth, but this place was no longer the earth.The memory that appeared from nowhere told Huo Hai that the place he was at at this time was the spiritual continent.In other words, it should be a very remote place in the spiritual continent.

The country he is in is the Nanyun Kingdom among the Thirteen Kingdoms of Nanling. It is in the south of the Spirit World Continent. He doesn't know where it is specifically.Moreover, this person's name is actually the same as his own, both are called Huo Hai.

I just don’t know if my family had the same thoughts as my grandfather when they came up with this name.In a few days, it will be Huo Hai's grandma's 90th birthday. Huo Hai left home and wanted to capture a spiritual beast.

It's a pity that his eyesight is not very good, and he actually provoked the Thunder Rat in the spiritual blood realm, and his soul was broken up.Of these two fellow sufferers, one has died physically and the other has died soul.I don't know what happened, but his soul actually came to Huo Hai's body and completely took his place.What is this, reviving a dead body?

And this seems to be soul time travel. Is there really such a thing as time travel in this world? Huo Hai was filled with doubts.

The only thing that is certain is that this guy named Huo Hai, like himself, reads the books of sages and is a truly good person.There is no chance to do big good deeds, but small good deeds are always indispensable.

In the eyes of his servants, Huo Hai is a very good young master who is respected by his servants.This time the injury was so bad that the two guards who followed him felt very uncomfortable.Now he is punishing himself corporally and apologizing to Huo Hai.

"Hey, it's true that good people don't live long, and the two of us actually share the same fate. Forget it, I have already sworn that if there is another life, I will never be a good person. Just let me do your share as well." Huo Hai made up his mind to be a bad guy.As for how to do it, he will have to study it slowly in the future. He has no experience in this area.

I don’t know how much time has passed, but Huo Hai from the spiritual world finally integrated all the soul fragments into Huo Hai’s soul.

Perhaps because his soul was shattered by lightning before, the memories Huo Hai received were intermittent, with only some fragments.All the memories before the age of ten have disappeared, leaving only the memories of the past few years.

Even so, the closer the time gets, the clearer it becomes that many things have disappeared.What he remembers most clearly is probably the cause of his own death."Hmph, Thunder Rat, I will help you get revenge."

Huo Hai said loudly in his heart: "From now on, I will be Huo Hai of the Huo family. Don't worry, I will help you live with your share, and I will help you take care of your family." After saying this, Huo Hai felt relieved.I don't know if it resonated with the dead Huo Hai, or if it really made me feel better, and even my body felt a lot better.

When Huo Hai opened his eyes again, two familiar yet unfamiliar faces appeared in front of Huo Hai again.There was also an unknown old man, one hand facing him, a faint green light flickering.

Under this light, Huo Hai felt his body warm, and the previous pain seemed to have disappeared.When the old man saw Huo Hai waking up, he breathed a sigh of relief, harvested his spiritual power, and wiped his sweat.

"Fortunately, my master has woken up." The old man bowed his hands and saluted the Huo family's residence. He was the Huo family's medical spiritual master.

Huo Kai nodded: "Excuse me, you should go and rest first. Xiaocui, take the old man to get a spiritual stone." Huo Kai greeted, and a servant left here with the medical spiritual master.Huo Kai himself and the old lady looked at Huo Hai nervously, worried that he would feel uncomfortable again.Huo Haike really scared the two of them.

Huo Hai felt warm in his heart as he looked at the two team members who looked concerned.But what to say? His ex left him too little memory. Huo Hai organized his words and thought about what he should say.
